summary.text: Jerry Neyer is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 92 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer who co-operates his family's dairy farm, he chairs the House Agriculture Committee.

paragraphs.text: Neyer was born in Isabella County, Michigan, and lives in Shepherd.
He co-operates his family's dairy farm and has served on the Isabella County Farm Bureau, the Michigan Dairy Marketing Committee and the Isabella County Planning Commission.
Neyer succeeded Democrat Terry Sabo in District 92.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Agriculture Committee and serves on the Insurance, Regulatory Reform and Transportation committees.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Luke Del Castillo in the general election on November 3, 2026.
